android._comment: allowMixedContent stays false. A release build serves the app from https://localhost, and true would let any http:// subresource or XHR load into that origin — on shop wifi that is an injection point for a bearer token the webview is holding. Debug builds reach a plaintext dev API through android/app/src/debug/res/xml/network_security_config.xml instead, which is scoped to three known hosts.

StatusBar._comment: overlaysWebView false: by default Android draws the status bar ON TOP of the webview, which hid the till's 60px header entirely. env(safe-area-inset-top) would normally compensate, but Capacitor's safe-area CSS injection fails on this webview (visible in logcat as 'Error injecting safe area CSS'), so the inset resolves to 0 and nothing moves out of the way.
